outcome_contract.planned_risk_r: cost-adjusted entry minus cost-adjusted planned stop
outcome_contract.stop: lowest completed session low through the signal bar
outcome_contract.stop_gap_fill: worse of stop and observed bar open
outcome_contract.target: prior close or raw 2R above entry, whichever is nearer; target must remain above entry
outcome_contract.target_gap_fill: target price without favorable gap improvement

selection_contract.asset_gate: frozen candidate is attested common stock with 09:30 open strictly above 5 dollars
selection_contract.daily_selection: earliest entry, then most negative gap, then lexical symbol
selection_contract.gap_gate: 09:30 open divided by prior completed regular-session close minus one is within -0.08 through -0.02 inclusive
selection_contract.miss_policy: missing prior close, invalid bars, nonpositive stop distance, or nonpositive target distance remains in denominator and cannot signal
selection_contract.session_vwap: cumulative volume-weighted typical price (high plus low plus close divided by three) through the completed signal bar
selection_contract.stabilization: the decision-time session low was established before the ten completed one-minute bars ending with the signal bar; equal lows do not reset the clock
selection_contract.trigger: completed close strictly above both session open and session VWAP

source_selection.date_rule: all 100 frozen dates with no substitutions
source_selection.prior_close_rule: IBKR complete daily summary for the prior exchange session named by the frozen bundle
